name: Oshamambe (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Oshamambe town emblem in red: a stylised letter E of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Oshamambe, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 29 August 1973.

features.role: Oshamambe town emblem — a stylised letter E of curved strokes
